item.tib: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro dgongs pa 'dus gsang ba ye shes mnyes bskang phyir tshogs mchod dngos grub rgya mtsho
item.coloph: ces tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor thabs mchog thun dngos grub gter mdzod 'di ni/ rgyal mo rgya yi rong chen dbang phyug ri yi byang phyogs/ mkha' 'gro 'du gnas ke'u tshangs (tshang) nyi ma rang shar du/ me 'brug 'bras ldan zla tshes la/ skal ldan blo yi dga' ston chen po ru/ sdom pa gsum gyis brgyan pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ 'ja' tshon snying pos bgyis pa/ dge legs dar rgyas 'phel bar shog
